author: @kingflares2
text:
Additional Clip for the idiots who think she's not good. You just have to know how to scale and get 50 satiety stacks. I could've killed turn 3/4. But I wanted to show how much shielding/healing she does.

It should be over 3k when whaled and the healing should be quite higher. However. I cannot run a whale one through. She does too much dmg currently. I ran the cassiah and xu. As they are there to deal no damage and nerf the team. Tentacles would kill mobs before I could stall. I also had to remove all dmg amp from my team to reduce my damage.

Not HER BIS team. It works. Cause she is so strong I'm literally trying to find units that gimp her so II can hit the satiety stacks. Her exalt with ring of chamber kills mob waves a5 currently. I can't remove ring as its her BiS for the showcase. 

This is e3 2000 shield which is more than the current champ castor. The naut wheel is added after the other wheel effects. She is a premier staller for the new difficulty if I'm guessing. A whale hi
